name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Stable Bootstrap V2: onOpen builds a local menu and never calls GitHub/UrlFetch from the simple trigger.
AI backlog action is visible directly in the SOCIAL AIO menu.
AI provider can be OpenAI or Google Gemini.
Google Sheets itself does not need an API key; Gemini API key is only required when Gemini is selected as the AI provider.
Default OpenAI model is gpt-5.6-luna; default Gemini model is gemini-3.5-flash.
